subject: Delegated admin controls & SCIM delta - evidence and least-privilege mapping
messages:
From: Aaron Li <aaron.li@healthsync.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com, security@healthsync.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delegated admin controls + SCIM delta request

Hi Soojin,

We're in the middle of our security intake for Redwood as part of our SOC 2 readiness. Two specific asks where we need concrete evidence:

1) Delegated admin / super-admin mapping: a matrix showing which roles at Redwood are able to perform tenant-level actions (create/delete tenants, change SSO settings, perform user exports). We need the role name, minimum number of people with the role, and an explanation of how least-privilege is enforced.

2) SCIM delta logs and reconciliation plan: we need a delta export (last 30 days) showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for our account, plus your description of how you handle SCIM failures and eventual consistency (retries, conflict resolution, retry intervals).

Also please include a sample SAML assertion (sanitized) showing the attributes you map for groups/roles. If you have a short remediation SLA for provisioning failures, include that too.

Target date: can you share these artifacts by end of week (Sept 30)? If you need more time, let me know a realistic ETA.

Thanks,
Aaron
Security Engineering
HealthSync

--
Aaron Li
security@healthsync.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@healthsync.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Delegated admin controls + SCIM delta request

Aaron — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the matrix, SCIM delta export for the last 30 days, and a redacted SAML assertion sample by EOD Sep 30. Quick notes and plan: 

- Who's on this thread internally: Jonas (identity lead) will pull SCIM deltas and logs; Naomi (compliance) will prepare the delegated-admin matrix and the least-privilege justification.
- SCIM exports: we'll include a CSV of events + a short narrative describing our retry/backoff and reconciliation behavior.
- Delegated admin matrix: will include role definitions, allowed tenant-level actions, current seat counts, and how we use RBAC + approval workflows to limit assignments.
- SAML sample: assertion will be sanitized (no PII) and show group -> role mapping used for HealthSync.
- Attachments: we'll deliver a ZIP with the logs plus an XLSX matrix and a plain-text SAML sample.

If HealthSync wants an engineer walk-through of the deltas or a short call to review mappings, we can do 30 minutes on Thu afternoon (I can propose times).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: ACTION: HealthSync SCIM delta + delegated-admin matrix (ETA EOD 9/30)

Team — looping you in to assemble the artifacts for HealthSync. Aaron requested evidence by 9/30. Please see the deliverables and owner below: 

- SCIM delta export (last 30 days) + incident log summaries (owner: Jonas): include timestamps, user id, operation (create/update/replace/delete), status (success/failure), error codes for failures. Provide one sample failure and the remediation timeline. Provide the export as CSV and one compressed archive (scim_delta_log_20260928.zip).

- Delegated admin matrix (owner: Naomi): spreadsheet with rows for each Redwood role that can perform tenant-level actions. Columns: role_name, canonical_permissions, examples_of_actions, min_admins_assigned, assignment_process, approval_gate (yes/no), review_frequency. Add a short paragraph (150-200 words) explaining least-privilege enforcement and periodic attestation process.

- SAML assertion sample (owner: Jonas): sanitize values (replace emails with user+hash, remove any PII). Show group-to-role mapping for HealthSync. Save as sso_assertion_samples.txt.

- Put artifacts in the HealthSync Drive folder and mark links in the email when done. Naomi, please include a sentence confirming there are no emergency break-glass accounts for tenant settings.

Let me know if ETA slips — prefer visibility sooner rather than later.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron.li@healthsync.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Delegated admin matrix + SCIM delta export for HealthSync (attachments + links)

Aaron — attaching the requested artifacts for HealthSync. Summary of contents below; full artifacts are in the Drive link included and a ZIP attached for quick ingestion.

Summary (high level):
- Delegated admin matrix (delegated_admin_matrix_healthsync.xlsx):
  - Roles with tenant-level capabilities: "Tenant Admin", "Support Admin". Tenant Admins can perform SSO config and tenant deletion (rare, requires two-person approval). Support Admins can perform user exports and assist with recovery; they cannot change SSO settings.
  - Min admins: Tenant Admins = 2 (on-call rotation), Support Admins = 4.
  - Least-privilege: we enforce attribute-based RBAC for application flows, and a monthly attestation that reviews assignments. Tenant-level actions require either two distinct approvers via our admin approval workflow or an authorized ticket in our internal change system.

- SCIM delta export (scim_delta_log_20260928.zip):
  - CSV includes 28 days of provisioning events (create/update/delete/replace) for account HealthSync. Each event has a timestamp, resource id, operation, status, and error code if any. Summary: 312 successful operations, 3 transient failures (all retried automatically; one required manual reconciliation due to mismatched external id).
  - Remediation SLA: automatic retry policy (0, 5, 15, 60 minutes), then escalates to a reconciliation queue monitored by identity engineers with a target ack within 4 hours and resolution within 48 hours for non-urgent issues. Critical failures escalate to on-call.

- SAML assertion sample (sso_assertion_samples.txt): redacted assertion showing attributes: email_hash, group_list -> role mapping, eduPersonPrincipalName replaced with hash. Notes on attribute mapping included.

Attachments: delegated_admin_matrix_healthsync.xlsx (XLSX), scim_delta_log_20260928.zip (ZIP), sso_assertion_samples.txt (TXT).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleHealthSyncEvidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/healthsync

If you'd like a quick walkthrough, Jonas and I are available Fri morning PT for a 30-minute call. Let us know a preferred time and we'll send an invite.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
